verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own fast cross-border rail: stablecoin-powered Instant Pay running 24/7 across 190+ countries, with settlement "in minutes" versus 24-48 hours via SWIFT. A cross-border payments page also says payments can settle "as fast as seconds," but that claim sits in the context of converting funds between Jeeves Cash accounts. Standard global payments are quoted only as arriving "as soon as the same day," so sub-minute arrival abroad is not clearly committed. Missing for 10: an explicit guarantee that outbound international transfers arrive in under a minute, corridor-level speed details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery times.
